name: Blaze Air Conditioning
address_note: Public business address as listed on Birdeye, MapQuest (via its Yelp data), hvacservice.io and fortlauderdaleac.org directories. Public records show this parcel as a residential property (Miramar West Estates), consistent with a home-based HVAC operation; the address is the one the business itself publishes on its listings, so it was used as given rather than substituted.
own_site_checked_domains: blazeairconditioning.com (given as already unresolved per task brief; re-confirmed: no DNS record)
own_site_check_result: No DNS record for any tested domain variant. Every directory listing found (Birdeye, Yelp via MapQuest, hvacservice.io, fortlauderdaleac.org, BuildZoom) shows no website link, only 'claim this listing to add a website'. blazeair.com and Blaze Air Inc (Winston-Salem, NC) / Blaze Heating Cooling Electrical Plumbing (Raleigh, NC) are unrelated out-of-state companies with a similar name, confirmed by address and area code mismatch. Confirmed: no own website.
review_count_source_note: 25 reviews on Google is the figure independently reported by both hvacservice.io and fortlauderdaleac.org (both citing Google). A separate, unclaimed Birdeye profile shows 30 reviews and MapQuest/Yelp shows a different, smaller review set (including one negative review) under a 'Blaze Air Conditioning, Hollywood FL' Yelp listing sharing the same address/zip. The task brief's figure of 25 on Google was used for the site and JSON-LD since it is corroborated by two independent directories citing Google specifically.

hours.source: hvacservice.io and fortlauderdaleac.org directory listings, both citing the business's published hours as 24/7.

social_search_result: No Facebook or Instagram profile found for this business after multiple targeted searches (business name, business name + Miramar, business name + phone number, business name + 'Dmitry').

license.source: BuildZoom contractor directory listing for 'Blaze Air Conditioning Inc' (page itself returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch; license number taken from a web search result summarizing that page's content). Not independently re-verified against the Florida DBPR lookup. Not displayed on the site to avoid publishing an unverified license number; kept here for reference only.

technician_name_note: First name only, mentioned by name in multiple real Google reviews (via fortlauderdaleac.org directory extraction) and visible on a 'BLAZE' branded cap and shirt in two of the downloaded photos. Referred to on the site as 'the technician' without an assumed last name or title, since neither was confirmed.

additional_reviews_found_not_used_on_sit: hvacservice.io summarized (not verbatim) additional reviews describing a technician recommending a replacement unit with a 10-year warranty instead of a repair, and multiple reviewers naming a technician called Dmitry.

A separate, unverified Yelp listing ('Blaze Air Conditioning, Hollywood, FL', surfaced via MapQuest) showed one 1-star review (Louis S., dated 12/9/2025): 'I tried to contact them many times and no response, I'm not sure they are in business anymore.' Not used as a testimonial (it is negative, and the task used the Google rating/review count, not the Yelp one); noted here for transparency.
A separate, unclaimed Birdeye profile shows 5.0 stars from 30 reviews with no readable verbatim text.

pricing_note: No prices are published anywhere for this business. Site uses the adapted variant per PIPELINE.md: 'get a free quote' CTAs instead of fabricated prices.

photos.source: Yelp business photos for the 'blaze-air-conditioning-hollywood' Yelp listing (same business, address shared across the 33027 zip spanning Miramar/Hollywood), surfaced through a MapQuest aggregator page that embeds that listing's Yelp photo IDs (s3-media0.fl.yelpcdn.com/bphoto/<id>/l.jpg). Downloaded via curl with a Chrome user agent, verified as real JPEGs with `file`, resized to max 1000px wide at quality 82 with Pillow.

palette: Custom cool steel-blue/teal palette derived from the business's real branded merchandise (navy 'BLAZE' cap and cobalt blue uniform shirt visible in the downloaded photos), not the amani original's warm mocha tones. No orange/flame palette was used since nothing in the real brand assets supports it; 'Blaze' is a name, not a visual theme the business actually uses.
build_variant: Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5: no exact pricing published anywhere, so services use 'get a free quote' CTAs instead of fabricated prices. Phone-based CTAs (call + SMS) instead of a booking link, since the business has no online booking system. Real street address is known and confirmed on multiple directories, so a live Google Maps iframe embed was used (not a substitute photo).
notes: No email or social media (Facebook/Instagram) was found for this business after deep research across Birdeye, Yelp (via MapQuest), hvacservice.io, fortlauderdaleac.org, BuildZoom and general web search. Outreach is pending_manual via phone/SMS to (954) 573-3191. The review count used (25, on Google) differs from the unclaimed Birdeye profile's 30 and from a separate Yelp listing under 'Blaze Air Conditioning, Hollywood, FL' sharing the same zip code; 25 was used because it is the figure two independent directories both attribute to Google specifically, matching the task brief.
